an4.38:1.1: panunnapaccekasacco bhikkhave, bhikkhu samavayasaṭṭhesano passaddhakāyasaṅkhāro patilīnoti vuccati.
an4.38:1.3: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhuno yāni tāni puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ puthupaccekasaccāni seyyathidaṃ:
an4.38:1.4: sassato lokoti vā asassato lokoti vā antavā lokoti vā anantavā lokoti vā taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti vā aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti vā hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā hoti ca na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā
an4.38:1.5: sabbānissa tāni panunnāni honti, cattāni vantāni muttāni pahīṇāni paṭinissaṭṭhāni.
an4.38:1.6: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu panunnapaccekasacco hoti.
an4.38:2.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhuno kāmesanā pahīṇā hoti, bhavesanā pahīṇā hoti, brahmacariyesanā paṭippassaddhā.
an4.38:2.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu samavayasaṭṭhesano hoti.
an4.38:3.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhaṃ asukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.38:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu passaddhakāyasaṅkhāro hoti.
an4.38:4.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhuno asmimāno pahīṇo hoti. ucchinnamūlo, tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato, āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo.
an4.38:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu patilīno hoti.
an4.38:4.4: panunnapaccekasacco bhikkhave, bhikkhu samavayasaṭṭhesano passaddhakāyasaṅkhāro patilīnoti vuccatīti.
